description: Build with Mzizi: the seven Mzizi agent skills (@nyuchi/mzizi-skills 0.11.0) in four categories: dev (digital-hygiene, progress-report), design (mzizi-design), language (mzizi-language) and build (mzizi-roots, mzizi-backend, discoverability), and the Mzizi MCP at mcp.mzizi.dev (free, no account; sign-in only for the Fundi tools). Owned and operated by Mzizi; live at mzizi.dev.
